name: Sian Ka'an
description: Sian Ka'an is a vast nature reserve on the Caribbean coast of Mexico's Yucatán peninsula, south of Tulum. Its name is Mayan for "Origin of the Sky." Across about 5,280 square kilometres, tropical forest, mangroves and marshes give way to a barrier reef offshore. More than 300 bird species live here, and the reserve also shelters 23 known Maya archaeological sites, including Muyil.
